name: Probability and Statistics
description: Basic set theory, axioms of probability, conditional probability and Bayes’ theorem; random variables, moments and moment generating functions, widely used random variables and their properties; multiple random variables, covariance and correlation; random samples, commonly used statistics, sampling distributions of statistics and their properties; types of probabilistic convergence, laws of large numbers and the central limit theorem; hypothesis testing, power function, type I and type II errors, the p-value, common hypothesis tests; introduction to linear regression. Assignments will be computational in nature in part, at minimum.
